subject: Re: Spectral energy distance TTS — kickoff
body:
Hi Goran,

Staffing: Kaia 60% (research lead), Jorge 50% (training infra), Gustavo 30%, Chiara 30% (serving integration later in the window).

Compute: repro and the internal-voice run fit our titan allocation. The July production-scale training is the big ask, and it is secured — we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-07-06, 512 accelerators, sized for the full parallel model plus the ablation pair. That reservation anchors the MOS panel timing, so protect it. Ines, cc for visibility.

Dependency: the MOS panel needs booking four weeks out; Chiara owns vendor logistics.

Flag: minibatch estimation is unbiased but variance depends on batch construction; Kaia wants same-speaker batches early.

Santiago
